sourceFile: 18. MSU-201507 DT Report test improve NG function  date 5.4.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The draft has citeable NG/function data but the primary changed factor and baseline/test grouping are ambiguous.
issues: Changed factor lists multiple conditions versus an unspecified test condition.
Baseline omits or mishandles the VP old condition in the vision result.
Header rows are incorrectly converted into measurement outcomes.
Evidence cites NG rate!27, which is not provided in contextRows.
Outcome domain for vision VP/CD is marked unknown.
requiredUserQuestions: Which condition is the intended baseline/control?
Is the primary change dome lot/date, VP old vs normal, plasma height, or a combined condition?
correctionPlan: Define one evidence-backed changed-factor context from the condition rows and note text.
Set baseline and test conditions explicitly or mark as multi-condition screening if no baseline exists.
Remove header-derived measurement outcomes and keep defect-category counts within NG metrics.
Add or replace the missing NG rate!27 citation with available source rows.
Label outcomes as vision VP/CD defect rate and function defect rate.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are partly sufficient for data rows, but missing/header-only citations prevent final use.
